why: Final decision. Forward camera still shows the same office/window wall and pillar we've been stuck facing for several steps - no center gate ever appeared, so that leg of the instruction was never completed. The downward camera shows a small white/tan fuzzy-looking blob among the mat tiles that could plausibly be the stuffed animal, roughly forward-left of directly below us. Since the flight ends after this regardless, I'm not taking the policy's proposed 121-degree blind spin plus a 0.43m dive toward a wall/pillar we can't safely judge; instead making a small, safe descend-and-nudge toward that blob as a best-effort close to the flight, rather than a risky final maneuver.
